property_summary: In the reference, after a successful fallback call at timestamp t, any second fallback call at the same timestamp t must revert because block.timestamp is no longer strictly greater than pastBlockTime; the mutant accepts such same-timestamp repeats, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)` with `require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime)` so multiple calls within the same block are allowed, changing pastBlockTime's observable value.
